verses.text: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

segments.text: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

verses.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

segments.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

verses.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

segments.text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

segments.text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

verses.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

segments.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

verses.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

segments.text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

verses.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

segments.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

segments.text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

verses.text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

segments.text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

verses.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

segments.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

segments.text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

verses.text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

segments.text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

verses.text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

segments.text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
